column7: A login (and every other session-issuing op: MFA verify, WebAuthn finish, SAML ACS, OIDC callback, impersonation start, refresh) that reported failure left a live Session the client never received: a panic in the post-mint identity read or step-up grant write, or CreateSession/RotateSession effect-then-error. Identity is now resolved before the mint, post-mint best-effort writes are panic-safe, and a session write that errored is read back by token (delivered if it landed; deleted and audited on panic). Oracle (f) in checkOraclesReporting plus TestUndeliveredSessionSweep guard the class
